The minimum inspection program for empirically designed masonry, glass unit masonry and masonry veneer designed in accordance with Section 2109, 2110, or Chapter 14 of this code, respectively, or by Chapter 5, 6 or 7 of TMS 402 as modified by Chapter 21 of this code, in structures classified as Risk Category IV, in accordance with Table 1604.5, shall comply with Table 1705.4.1 of this code.
Table 1705.4.1

Level B Required Special Inspections and Tests of Masonry Construction
